title: MixConfig: Mixing Configurations for Downstream Prediction
description: Official implementation of the ICML 2026 paper 'Mixing Configurations for Downstream Prediction'. MixConfig is a plug-and-play feature augmentation module that extracts structurally stable clustering configurations from a frozen embedding and learns energy-aware mixing weights per sample for downstream prediction.
